biocontainers.name: bioconductor-rcwl
biocontainers.summary: Wrap Command Tools and Pipelines Using CWL

biotools.summary: The Common Workflow Language (CWL) is an open standard for development of data analysis workflows that is portable and scalable across different tools and working environments. Rcwl provides a simple way to wrap command line tools and build CWL data analysis pipelines programmatically within R. It increases the ease of usage, development, and maintenance of CWL pipelines.
